result_text:
`analyzeLandscape` is now a second name for `updateLandscape`, with the same options and behaviour. The module compiles and packages offline. I could not check the help output or run the command end to end, because `java -jar` calls were refused as needing approval.

Changes, none committed:

- **`Commands.java`**: added `ANALYZE_LANDSCAPE` and its description. The description says it is the landscape counterpart of the analysis commands and the same as `updateLandscape`. The no-argument usage overview now lists `analyzeLandscape` next to `updateLandscape`.
- **`CommandLineInterface.java`**: both names dispatch to the same `updateLandscape` method. That method now takes the command name and description the user typed, so `-help` prints the usage under that name. `updateLandscape -help` still prints its own usage.
- **`README.md`**: the README had no command list, so I added a short "Landscape" section describing `analyzeLandscape`, noting it is the same as `updateLandscape`, and showing an example.

I did not add a test. The existing `mvn -o -pl cli test` run passed with no output (quiet mode), but I did not confirm that a test class ran.
